manual_deductions: DNF and parity-shift inner upper bound k+k*2^k+4m.
Exact nearest-junta distance by blockwise majority, then an ordinary gate-list implementation.
Disagreement support gives junta center separation; opposite parity shifts are balanced when 2k<m.
Strictly separated Hamming balls cannot share an accepting coordinate subcube.
At fixed beta<1/3, small outer recognizers have exponent 1+H(beta)+o(1) while accepting only low-complexity tables.
